reports.title: Teck Reports Unaudited Third Quarter Results for 2026

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: • | Our guidance, which is outlined in summary below and our usual guidance tables, including 2027–2028 production guidance, can be found on pages 30–33 of Teck’s third quarter results for 2026 at the link below.

• | Our previously disclosed 2026 annual production guidance is unchanged, including for QB despite severe weather impacts in Q3 2026. As a result of strong operational performance through September 30, 2026, we expect our 2026 annual production to be towards the high end of our previously disclosed guidance ranges for copper production at HVC, zinc in concentrate production at Red Dog and refined zinc production at Trail. As a result of the significant impact of extreme weather conditions in Q3 at Carmen de Andacollo, we expect our 2026 annual copper production to be at the low end of our previously disclosed guidance.

• | As a result of strong year-to-date by-product pricing, we have reduced our 2026 annual copper net cash unit cost1 guidance to US$1.80–$2.00 per pound compared to our previously disclosed guidance range of US$1.85–$2.20 per pound.

• | We have also reduced our 2026 annual zinc total cash unit cost1 guidance to US$0.70–$0.80 per pound, compared to our previously disclosed guidance of US$0.80–$0.90 per pound, and our 2026 annual zinc net cash unit cost1 guidance to US$0.30–$0.40 per pound, compared to our previously disclosed guidance of US$0.65–$0.75 per pound, due to strong year-to-date cost performance and by-product pricing.
5 | Teck Resources Limited 2026 Third Quarter News Release

• | As previously disclosed, we are advancing construction of Rock Bench 6 at the QB TMF, which was not included in our 2026 annual capital expenditure guidance, and as a result, we expect our 2026 annual sustaining capital expenditures to be in the top half of our previously disclosed guidance range of $1.3–$1.5 billion. The year-to-date increase in diesel costs has directly impacted our capitalized stripping costs and we expect our 2026 annual capitalized stripping expenditures to be at the high end of our previously disclosed guidance range of $455–$560 million.

• | The Red Dog shipping season commenced on July 12, 2026 and is expected to be completed by early November 2026. We expect sales of zinc in concentrate at Red Dog to be in the range of 65,000 to 75,000 tonnes in the fourth quarter of 2026, reflecting the normal seasonality of Red Dog sales.
